title: Three Plains, a first-strike block, and a fallen Juggernaut
era: 1996 World Championship Standard using current first-strike combat rules
story: My opponent attacked with Juggernaut , a 5/3 that had to attack if able. I blocked with Order of Leitbur , which had been under my control since the previous turn. I tapped three Plains , using one white mana to give Order first strike and two to give it +1/+0. Now a 3/1 first striker, Order dealt three damage before regular combat damage and destroyed Juggernaut. Order lived because the dead attacker never dealt its five damage. I held Swords to Plowshares in reserve; the three-mana block had solved this combat without another spell.
review: Order 2/1, spend W to grant first strike and WW for +1/+0. 3/1 first strike deals lethal 3 to artifact Juggernaut 5/3 before it hits back. Juggernaut may be blocked by non-Wall. Three Plains pay 3W, Swords in actual 1996 white deck.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
